name: Phenylpiracetam
addictionPotential: non-addictive with a low potential for abuse
toxicity: safe even when high doses are consumed for a long period of time
summary: A nootropic and piracetam analogue also known as fonturacetam. This drug has been shown to have potential memory enhancing, anxiolytic, anti-amnesia and anti-depressive effects. However the drug has reportedly little recreational value. Around 45x more potent than Piracetam.
advisory: Rapid onset. Typically taken up to three times a day.
doseBasis: Rapid onset. Typically taken up to three times a day.

tolerance.buildUp: develops with prolonged and repeated use
